text:
maria: Quick sync — we need a customer-facing sample payload plus a short validation checklist for the audit-event schema changes touching RBAC grants and KMS key ops. Target: documentation + a tiny change log.

alex: I can draft the sample payload. Do we want full envelope with metadata, or minimal example?

maria: Minimal + one full example showing RBAC grant/revoke and KMS key-rotate. Customers usually ask for both.

sam: From runtime side: include fields: event_type, user_id, actor_type (service|user), resource_type, resource_id, rbac_action (grant|revoke|perm-check), prev_permissions, new_permissions, kms_action (encrypt|decrypt|rotate|create), kms_key_id, request_id, timestamp, region, outcome (success|failure), reason (optional).

janet: Add a note about PII — redact or hash any user email in sample. Also include an example of a masked payload we’d send to non-admins.

oliver: For KMS rotation specifically, we should include old_key_fingerprint and new_key_fingerprint (or null), and a link to KMS rotation docs in the sample comment.

maria: Great. Alex, can you post the JSON snippet here and then we iterate wording for the changelog blurb?

alex: Posting quick sample:```json
{
  "event_type":"audit.log",
  "timestamp":"2026-05-02T15:12:03Z",
  "request_id":"req_5b2c9a",
  "actor_type":"user",
  "user_id":"user_1234",
  "resource_type":"project",
  "resource_id":"proj_987",
  "rbac_action":"grant",
  "prev_permissions":[],
  "new_permissions":["deploy","view_logs"],
  "kms_action":"rotate",
  "kms_key_id":"kms_az1_prod_01",
  "old_key_fingerprint":"sha256:aaa...",
  "new_key_fingerprint":"sha256:bbb...",
  "outcome":"success",
  "region":"us-west-2"
}
```

janet: That looks good. For customer preview we should include a second example where outcome=failure and reason set to a brief code (e.g., AUTHZ_DENIED).

sam: Ops note — make sure event size remains small; customers ingest into SIEMs. We should recommend the compact schema in docs and add a sample full payload only for debugging.

alex: I'll add the failure example and a compact version. Also add a short validation checklist: 1) Schema v3 presence check for required fields, 2) RBAC action mapping table included, 3) KMS ops enumerated, 4) No raw PII (emails hashed), 5) Timestamp in ISO8601 UTC, 6) request_id present.

maria: Perfect. One more: we changed RBAC enum values -> need to communicate to customers about mapping from older enums. Can we include a migration note with a mapping table?

oliver: Yes — include a tiny mapping: old_grant->grant, old_revoke->revoke, legacy_check->perm-check. Also call out that older SDKs will still emit legacy enums for 30 days while we roll.

alex: Draft changelog blurb: "Audit events: schema update v3 — added detailed RBAC and KMS fields (rbac_action, prev_permissions, new_permissions, kms_action, old_key_fingerprint, new_key_fingerprint). Backwards-compatible enums supported for 30 days; see migration mapping."

janet: For customer-facing validation: propose a 3-step quick checklist customers can run in their sandbox: 1) send sample events, 2) confirm mapping in their SIEM, 3) run a sample query for revoke/grant events. I can convert to a one-pager.

maria: Good. Security question: vuln triage — if someone reports an audit injection risk (malicious fields), what's our stance? We should recommend server-side validation and whitelist enums. Also add a note for customers to treat incoming events as data only and not execute any fields.

sam: Ops: we'll add a server-side schema validator and a log sanitizer that strips suspicious fields. We'll add this to the rollout plan.

maria: Last bit — communications plan: 1) internal announce to customers success/sales, 2) docs + downloadable sample payloads, 3) 2-week preview period with opt-in, 4) GA and 30-day dual-enum fallback, 5) post-GA migration enforcement.

security-bot: Incident alert template suggested: "Audit-schema-change-v3: If customers report missing events or mapping errors, collect request_id, sample payload, customer SIEM mapping rules, and environment (region/SDK-version)."

maria: Thanks — Alex/Janet, please share the initial PR for docs + sample payload one hour. Sam/Oliver, add sanitizer + migration flags to the rollout checklist. We'll sync tomorrow at 10am PT. :thumbsup:

alex: On it.

janet: I’ll draft the one-pager and link it in the PR.

sam: I'll open infra ticket for validator + sanitizer.

oliver: I'll add rotation fingerprint fields to the model and note KMS docs link.

maria: Closing thread — will follow up in the PR comments.
